title: Prompted summarise the pros and cons of scrypt vs argon2 for a key file

safeHtmlItem.html:
scrypt: built into Node, memory-hard, well understood.

argon2: newer & tunable, but needs a native module.

  • For a personal vault scrypt N=2^17 is fine
  • Use a 16-byte random salt

title: Prompted translate "your memory, your file" into Portuguese

safeHtmlItem.html:
In Go you would use crypto/aes with cipher.NewGCM:
block, _ := aes.NewCipher(key)
gcm, _ := cipher.NewGCM(block)

title: Prompted show me the python version with the cryptography library

safeHtmlItem.html:
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers.aead import AESGCM
aesgcm = AESGCM(key)
ct = aesgcm.encrypt(nonce, data, aad)

The tag is appended to the ciphertext — the last 16 bytes.

title: Prompted What is the best way to learn Rust?

safeHtmlItem.html:
There are several good ways to learn Rust:
  • Read The Rust Programming Language (the "book")
  • Do the rustlings exercises
  • Port a small tool you already wrote in Go

Since you mentioned Go & Solidity, ownership will be the new idea; traits will feel familiar.
